subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The flight was about to take off when suddenly the authorities came to ensure the record of the __maintanance__ department.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"maintanance"** is incorrect. The correct spelling is **"maintenance"**. (रखरखाव)

 
 
• **Example: **The maintenance of the building is carried out every month.
 
 
 
• **"Maintenance" **refers to the process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved. (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example: **Regular maintenance of machinery is crucial for its long-term functionality.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling of the word is **"maintenance"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maintnance **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "maintenance".

 
 
• **Example:** The word "maintnance" does not exist in English.
 
 
 
• **Maintainance **(गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "maintenance".
 
 
• **Example: **The word "maintainance" is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Maintainence** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "maintenance".
 
 
• **Example:** The word "maintainence" is not spelled correctly.
